{{Top|leg}}
The '''Peregrine-240''' was a model of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] produced by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]] during the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Characteristics==
The Peregrine-240 swoop measured 3.25 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, and could accommodate a pilot and a single passenger. It could attain speeds in excess of 350 kilometers per hour under ideal conditions.

==Behind the scenes==
The Peregrine-240 swoop was incorrectly referred to as the [[Peregrine-340 airspeeder|Peregrine-340]] in [[Star Wars Gamer 4|Star Wars Gamer, issue 4]].
